text: the walker, seeing Deli Counter 0.258.0's scout view (296): "its ok for now, but i want to make it look more polished and artistic so it could ship to players....They can scout out the buildings and rotate the schemas in a 360 degree way". This item now carries that: a scout MODEL of each building -- the scout view's signals (walls cut low, doors and windows, stairs as treads, ladders, holes; storeys lifted apart; no furniture or labels) as a mesh a player turns all the way round -- shipped in each building's package and named by `buildings.json`, with a reference viewer scene (its own world, an orbit camera, storeys apart and together) to show the walker; judged as art, by frames the walker picks a style from, and priced as runtime content before it ships (one material, colour in vertex data; draws and frame time at the viewer). The in-game screen stays the game's. Not started.
